report.source: UCI Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits, Alpaydin & Kaynak (1998), CC BY 4.0; historical sklearn subset
report.split: Chapter18 observed roles, not writer independent/fresh confirmation
report.notes: No model/seed/epoch search. DDPM simplified unweighted epsilon MSE, cosine32 schedule. DDIM eta0 with clipped x0 and unchanged epsilon direction;8/32 steps, common initial noise. Class-conditioned toy-scale MLP is not text-to-image. Alignment is supervised image/class-name lookup retrieval among10 known labels, not CLIP, natural language understanding, caption training or zero-shot transfer. UI aliases are authored label names, not observed captions.
